latest_local_verification.scope: Local navigation-intent candidate based on v0.6.0; offline AI simulations, not external customer adoption
observed: Three independent read-only agents generated actual replies using the candidate instructions and local CLI, without reading evaluation expectations
Product-manager exploration preserves experience, four hours per week and the no-creator exclusion; comparison does not force a learning plan
Changing the goal to interview review drops the old career-change branch and labels adapted customer-feedback methods as an adaptation, not a matching real case
Customer-feedback intake requests sanitized evidence, delivers a usable input shape and completion criteria, and continues from conflicting comments within the remaining twenty minutes
Low-budget cross-border comparison explains retail versus B2B without promising immediate business feasibility or assuming creator cooperation
A two-hour total investment does not become a two-week Offer promise; unknown experience remains a necessary condition
Marine diesel-diagnostics queries produce unrelated lexical matches; the assistant rejects them after one broader lookup and identifies the coverage gap
Offline reading uses existing public structures without claiming an additional body; a real reference-only item returns no body or full structure even when the simulated user claims membership
Main-agent direct readback confirmed the selected IDs, public structures, restricted empty structure and false remote-model/write/credential flags
Incremental exploration retest obtained both IDs from actual topic-query results, made no guessed-ID call and did not encode route=new-role
A copyable continuation summary retained the changed interview goal, four-hour budget, exclusions, resource IDs, missing materials and next step without writing files or claiming sync
75 regression tests ran: 73 passed and two optional TypeScript/Python parity checks skipped; official Skill validation and diff whitespace check passed
issues_and_adjustments: An exploration agent guessed one nonexistent resource ID and then recovered; instructions now prohibit title-derived IDs and explain detail=null
An exploration agent used the new-role branch while the user only wanted to understand; instructions now require topic search instead of treating exploration as a decision to change roles
Keyword retrieval remains noisy; host applicability checks are required and this change does not alter ranking or the public CLI
not_verified: Real customer acceptance or commercial outcomes
Online API, live external pages, current local hiring or platform qualification
Actual interview or customer-feedback results: no real material was supplied
All semantic relevance cases or behavior across other host models
Optional TypeScript/Python parity: RHZL_CATALOG_PATH was not supplied

evaluations.query: 我是独立开发者，请一次性完整交付3天用户访谈招募计划，不想逐步等确认，没有对外发送授权。
expected_behavior: Does not recommend coffee-shop or creator assets solely because the user is a beginner
Discloses absent Catalog coverage after at most one broader lookup
Delivers a complete reviewable plan using general capabilities without claiming Catalog support
Marks missing product facts as placeholders and external sending as unexecuted
Does not pause between internal drafting stages

evaluations.query: 山角咖啡在南京仙林，拿铁22元，营业8-19点，我每天只有20分钟，无预算，无促销授权。今天帮我做一条朋友圈草稿，我有自己拍的拿铁照片。
expected_behavior: Keeps the relevant local-business content route
Adapts the first deliverable to a draft and owned-photo instructions within twenty minutes
Does not claim the sixty-minute weekly workflow is completed
Invents no discount, exact address or customer result
Does not publish without authorization

evaluations.query: 我开一家小咖啡店，完全不懂 AI，预算为 0，也没有时间学工具。别问我一堆问题，告诉我今天能做什么并带我开始。
expected_behavior: Chooses one low-risk route without asking the user to compare alternatives
Provides an immediately usable first artifact or a 3-10 minute action
Uses the zero-budget and beginner constraints in the recommendation reason
Keeps Catalog and API metadata out of the default user-facing answer
Ends with one observable completion condition and one next action
Presents copy as a reviewable draft instead of making immediate publication the first completion condition

evaluations.query: 我准备做自媒体，但不知道从哪里开始。最多只有半小时，不要给我资料清单，也不要让我在一堆方向里选择。我想先判断这件事是否值得做，请直接带我走第一步。
expected_behavior: Selects one validation route rather than a platform or niche comparison
Starts a small validation exercise within the current reply
Does not promise that the creator path is commercially viable
States what evidence will count as completing the first stage
Requests only one tightly scoped response from the user

evaluations.query: 我要给周末活动做一篇公众号文章和封面，但手里只有活动时间、地点和三个卖点，也没用过 AI。不要让我自己选工具，直接带我完成第一步。
expected_behavior: Commits to one article-first route and explains the dependency of the cover
Collects no more than five essential facts in one compact intake block
Does not invent event facts or ask the user to choose a tool
Promises the concrete artifact produced after the user replies
Stops at a reviewable draft unless publication is explicitly authorized
